title: OpenAI finds ChatGPT users increasingly cross occupational task boundaries
friendlyTitle: AI is helping people do tasks from other kinds of jobs
summary: OpenAI’s analysis of work-related ChatGPT use describes “task crossover”: people using AI to perform tasks historically associated with occupations other than their own. The pattern suggests AI is broadening the mix of work individuals can attempt, rather than changing every role in the same way.
friendlySummary: OpenAI found that people use ChatGPT for work that was once more common in other professions. This is called task crossover.
whyItMatters: Small teams and independent workers may gain access to capabilities that previously required another specialist, but access is not the same as expertise. Workplaces need review standards and training for high-stakes tasks that cross professional boundaries.
friendlyWhyItMatters: A small team may be able to do more by itself. But important legal, financial, medical or technical work still needs expert checking.
